Fixed a few things:

 Game mode selector remembers your last choice even if you didn't start the game
 Fix issues related to game modes and dailies

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.notes:
This is a small update

 Probably fix an issue with the Shutdown Now achievement where the anticheat could give a false positive and not give the achievement (I guess?)
 Added a new game mode accessible after beating 200s on normal mode. This new game mode is named "Chaos Mode" and it just works like normal one but starts at the hardest difficulty (aka: Highest enemy spawn rate + all enemies already on pool). This is literally the same as the normal mode after reaching 800s, good luck!

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Cool news!
notes.notes:
Hi! Long time no see :)
I've been doing some fun stuff for 1.3, here is the list of changes:

Update 1.3

 Add: Daily run leaderboard
 Add: Player now can be controlled with arrow keys as well
 Add: Link to a fanmade discord server
 Add: Hide UI option.
 Fix: Mute all setting caused audio issues under certain conditions
 Fix: Issues with breaker hitbox.


Probably changed some other things I already forgot :P

notes.title: Merry christmas! Patch 1.2.3 released
notes.notes:
Hi! First of all, merry christmas to everyone!
Here are some of the changes for patch 1.2.3 released out now:


 Add an option so dashes can be done independent of the distance to the player (the actual dash distance will remain the same)
 Blocker enemies now show a glowing warning of their final positions (in such similar way as bombers and cyclers)
 Fullscreen is now enabled by default.
 Fix: Keeping the game window selected would make the delta time go very high, and that could be exploited.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.notes:
Here are some of the changes for this version

 Added a setting to not upload scores to the leaderboard at all
 Added a darker options to the hi-contrast back setting
 Added the total count of entries in the leaderboard under the top list
 Renamed "Hi-Contrast Back" to "Dim Background"
 Resized the leaderboard top from 17 to 16.
 Wiped out axiomatic hackers from the leaderboard.
